paper_title: Towards Predicting Any Human Trajectory In Context
caption: Performance change brought by different sizes of the in-context pool.

model_annotations.English: This line plot illustrates how the minimum FDE20 metric, measured in meters, changes across different values of the ratio parameter, ranging from 0.0 to 1.0 on a linear scale, for five different methods: TrajICL, Head Tuning, FT, LoRA 16, and LoRA 64. The y-axis, labeled "minFDE20 (m)", spans from 18 to 23 on a linear scale. The TrajICL method is represented by a solid blue line with circular markers, showing a consistent decline from approximately 20.5 at a ratio of 0.0 to 18.0 at a ratio of 1.0. The Head Tuning method is depicted by an orange line with circular markers, starting near 23.0 and generally decreasing slightly to around 22.5. The FT method is shown by a green line with circular markers, beginning at approximately 22.3, dipping to 21.8 around a ratio of 0.4, and then rising to about 21.1 at a ratio of 1.0. The LoRA 16 method is represented by a red line with circular markers, starting near 23.0 and decreasing to approximately 22.1 at a ratio of 1.0. The LoRA 64 method is shown by a purple line with circular markers, beginning near 23.0 and decreasing to approximately 22.1 at a ratio of 1.0.
model_annotations.German: This line chart illustrates how the minimum FDE20 metric (in meters) changes across different values of the ratio parameter, comparing the performance of five methods: TrajICL, Head Tuning, FT, LoRA 16, and LoRA 64. The x-axis, labeled “Ratio,” spans from 0 to 1.0 in increments of 0.2, with tick marks at 0, 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8, and 1.0. The y-axis, labeled “minFDE20 (m),” ranges from 18 to 23 in increments of 1, with tick marks at 18, 19, 20, 21, 22, and 23. The TrajICL line is blue with circular markers and a solid line, starting at approximately 20.5 m when the ratio is 0 and decreasing to 18.0 m at a ratio of 1.0. The Head Tuning line is orange with circular markers and a solid line, beginning at approximately 23.0 m and remaining relatively stable, fluctuating between approximately 22.5 m and 23.0 m. The FT line is green with circular markers and a solid line, starting at approximately 22.3 m, dipping to approximately 21.8 m at a ratio of 0.2, then rising to approximately 21.0 m at a ratio of 0.6, and ending at approximately 21.1 m at a ratio of 1.0. The LoRA 16 line is red with circular markers and a solid line, beginning at approximately 23.0 m and decreasing slightly to approximately 22.1 m at a ratio of 1.0. The LoRA 64 line is purple with circular markers and a solid line, starting at approximately 23.0 m and decreasing slightly to approximately 22.0 m at a ratio of 1.0.
